annotations.title: Generate Shipley RFP Compliance Matrix & Proposal Outline

description: Shred unstructured RFP Section C (SOW/PWS), Section L (Instructions), and Section M (Evaluation Criteria) text into a numbered `shall`/`must` Requirements Traceability Matrix, Section L-to-M cross-reference map, and annotated Proposal Outline with page allocations. This is a read-only, stateless analysis operation (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `raw_text` accepts 50 to 100,000 characters, and `proposal_methodology` selects 'shipley' [default Volume I-IV structure], 'federal_far' [FAR 15.3], or 'standard_b2b' outline conventions). Use this tool when shredding a base RFP into a compliance checklist and proposal outline; use `analyze_rfp_amendment_diff` instead when comparing an SF-30 amendment against a base RFP, or `generate_rfp_response` to draft the actual prose narrative for a specific section.

proposal_methodology.description: Proposal structuring methodology: 'shipley' (Shipley Associates capture standard), 'standard_b2b' (commercial enterprise RFP), or 'federal_far' (strict FAR Section L/M mapping).

raw_text.description: Raw RFP Section C (Statement of Work / PWS), Section L (Instructions to Offerors), and/or Section M (Evaluation Factors) text (50 to 100,000 characters).

name: generate_compliance_matrix

evaluation_criteria_weights.description: Extracted Section M or commercial evaluation scoring factors and relative weights.

proposal_outline.description: Structured section-by-section proposal outline with mapped requirements, win themes, and page budgets.

requirements_matrix.description: Ordered list of shredded RFP requirements mapped to proposal sections and required verification evidence.

solicitation_title.description: Inferred or stated title/scope of the RFP or Statement of Work.

submission_format_rules.description: Extracted administrative formatting, page limit, font, margin, or submission instructions that could trigger rejection if violated.

total_mandatory_shall_count.description: Total count of mandatory ('MANDATORY_SHALL') requirements identified in the text.

title: Generate Shipley RFP Compliance Matrix & Proposal Outline
